technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions with rising RSI suggest potential bounce, but price remains below all major moving averages with negative momentum indicators and no confirmed bullish crossovers—high-risk reversal setup lacking confluence.

fundamental.summary: CMS shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 29 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money support for conviction.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (16/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but weak congressional conviction and absent news data limit conviction; neutral composite signal.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (321.12) indicates extreme market stress, rising DXY pressures multinationals, and earnings in 29 days adds event risk to utilities sector already facing rate/credit environment deterioration.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme oversold conditions (RSI 9, Stoch RSI, Williams %R) with rising RSI suggest potential mean-reversion bounce, and fear-zone sentiment (16/100) presents contrarian opportunity near support.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price below all major moving averages with negative momentum (MACD, AO, CMF, OBV), zero technical confluence, severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, DXY headwind), high earnings risk in 29 days, and no fundamental/smart money support make this a low-probability reversal setup.

decision.entry_rationale: Extreme oversold conditions (RSI 9, Stoch RSI, Williams %R) with rising RSI suggest potential bounce, and fear-zone sentiment presents contrarian opportunity.
